name: Can an in-law suite have a full kitchen in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can an in-law suite have a full kitchen in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Can an in-law suite have a full kitchen in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether an in-law suite can include a full kitchen depends on how the unit is classified and approved. A permitted ADU often can include a complete kitchen, which makes it function like a separate living unit. A JADU or simpler conversion may have tighter limits and may be designed more like an expanded living space than a fully independent dwelling. The kitchen decision affects plumbing, electrical load, ventilation, and cabinet layout, so it should be planned early. Homeowners should also think about how the kitchen impacts privacy, resale appeal, and rental potential if the suite will ever be used that way. A design team can help determine the right classification before plans are drawn, which reduces the chance of costly redesigns later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many in-law suites can include a full kitchen if the project is permitted as an ADU or similar dwelling unit. A smaller JADU may have more limitations and may not follow the same kitchen layout expectations. The key issue is how the unit is classified, because that determines what features are allowed.
